title: Gap between Automation Buttons too big on small phone
body:
The automation buttons are (too) big on a small phone (e.g. Cubot KingKong Mini3)  
Please see pics below, first the old/normal view second the todays updated/new view.

Suggestion: extra space via user input-text and not hard coded.

![button_normal](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/62a778e5-6408-4fe6-b9fd-e9330bf4afdd)
![button_big](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/5c9f7d6d-b90f-4090-9ef6-8831a168289c)

comments.body:
In my mind the little space between each button (marging) is better compare to the overall grey bar for 5 different buttons we had before.
We should probably reduce the padding within each button to give more place for the text inside (in your screenshot about 2/3 of the width of each button is lost for the text and is in grey...

I completely agree. Even with cropped text (please see pic) there still is (imo too much) lost space.

![5button_txt_small](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e09ed5cf-dee1-46ad-bb34-7a2408cef416)
We can also think about the logo. It ios the sam for each button and therefroe does not add any value. Either use the logo for the (first?) action triggered or leave it out completely.
Sorry, why is the color lost? TEST2 looks like an OK one although it is a STOP with red quare in the original icon.
on the line bellow the text match the color of icon
I think it's cleaner with same color on icon/text, but either is fine.

more logical and size adjustable now. way better. thanks
![new_button_small](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c42c3279-e380-48e2-9247-82e87848148f)
